### 💡 Intuition & Approach
Average local gradients across data-parallel ranks via simulated All-Reduce and apply an identical parameter update across all replicas.

### ⚡ Python Reference Implementation
```python
import numpy as np

def cs336_l07_data_parallel_gradient_sync(rank_grads: list, lr: float = 0.01, param: list = None) -> dict:
    mean_g = np.mean(np.array(rank_grads, dtype=float), axis=0)
    p = np.array(param, dtype=float) if param is not None else np.zeros_like(mean_g)
    return {'mean_gradient': np.round(mean_g, 6).tolist(), 'updated_param': np.round(p - lr * mean_g, 6).tolist()}
```
